settings.heading: Do I need tires yet?
settings.lede: Every tire shop on earth will tell you the answer is yes. This one checks the two things that decide it — how much tread is left and how old the rubber is — and tells you plainly if the answer is no.
settings.promise: No sign-up and no contact details asked for. If your tires are fine the page says so and stops. No countdown, no pitch.
